# i18next

Pinned i18next 26.4.2 from https://registry.npmjs.org/i18next/-/i18next-26.4.2.tgz. Upstream: https://github.com/i18next/i18next. MIT licensed; see i18next.LICENSE.

`i18next.mjs` is the upstream `dist/esm/i18next.js` with its final export list removed and its existing `createInstance` constant exposed as a named export for the local bundler. The full MIT notice is prepended and embedded in the standalone HTML. No other runtime source changes. To update, repeat those changes, retain the notice, rebuild and run the full tests.
